question:
How many straight lines are there in the figure? (Don't consider the extra line if there is another line at 180 degrees) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28b7abaa585f893ff320ae70faa088c1982bab8108789f1dc98121d0760151a5.png]
solution:
The number of straight lines in the given figure is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8443c8210a3cb4b89010e5bf4381488d78993eac52e8ef20d4bca4fea5dc130.png] 

Thus, as marked there are a total of 5 straight lines.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] 

**__Mistake Points__** Straight Lines - A straight line is always a straight path between two points.

Simple Lines - It can be straight and also intersect themselves.
